List Registered Palettes

Source: R/color.R
pal_list.Rd

Browse palettes from the built-in collection (260 palettes from RColorBrewer, ggsci, viridis, rcartocolor, nord, dichromat, pals, colorspace, and UtilsR built-in). Use pattern to filter. Prints palette headings and optional swatches in the console. For a gt table or ggplot preview, use pal_show().

Usage

pal_list(
  pattern = NULL,
  type = c("all", "discrete", "continuous"),
  show = TRUE
)

Arguments

pattern

Single non-missing regex string to filter palette names. Default NULL shows all.

type

Filter by type: "all" (default), "discrete", or "continuous".

show

Single non-missing logical; if TRUE (default) display colour swatches. FALSE prints palette headings only.

Value

Invisibly returns a named list of matching palettes.

Details

Only palettes in palette_list are listed. Separate collections such as pal_heat and unregistered entries of pal_other are accessed directly rather than by registry name.

Palette names are kept in full on narrow consoles. Colour counts and types move to a separate line when they do not fit in a heading.

See also

Other colour palettes: pal_bar, pal_get(), pal_heat, pal_lancet, pal_other, pal_paraSC, pal_show(), pal_show_brewer(), pal_show_ggsci(), pal_show_hcl(), pal_show_viridis()

Examples

pal_list(pattern = "^Blues", show = FALSE)
#> 
#> ── Blues (9 colours, continuous) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
pal_list(pattern = "^Blues")
#> 
#> ── Blues (9 colours, continuous) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
#>  #F7FBFF   #DEEBF7   #C6DBEF   #9ECAE1   #6BAED6   #4292C6   #2171B5   #08519C  
#>  #08306B  
#> structure(c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#C6DBEF", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", 
#> "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C", "#08306B"), type = "continuous")
pal_list(type = "discrete", pattern = "nord")
#> 
#> ── nord_polarnight (4 colours, discrete) ───────────────────────────────────────
#>  #2E3440   #3B4252   #434C5E   #4C566A  
#> structure(c("#2E3440", "#3B4252", "#434C5E", "#4C566A"), type = "discrete")
#> 
#> ── nord_snowstorm (3 colours, discrete) ────────────────────────────────────────
#>  #D8DEE9   #E5E9F0   #ECEFF4  
#> structure(c("#D8DEE9", "#E5E9F0", "#ECEFF4"), type = "discrete")
#>
